questions.question: Does `src/components/context-meter.tsx` contain any vacuous path (frozen percentage, hard-coded level, tautological `data-level`) or a dependency (resolved window, fill) that silently renders 0%/ok when un-injected? State-discriminating: `grep -c "data-testid=\"context-meter\"" src/components/context-meter.tsx` is 0/file-absent pre-impl and >=1 post-impl.

Does S2 comply with architecture.md: presentational meter component fed by the composition root or a hook, percentage from the shared `contextPercent` only, no meter logic under `server/` (`grep -rn "computeContextFill\|showContextMeter" server/` returns nothing), and no component importing another component's internals?

Could `meter-ui` be deleted and rewritten without modifying any file outside its `dependencies_allowed` list? If not, which cross-module dependencies exist (sidebar-prefs, context-window, backend-http-client) and do they flow through declared seam contracts (S-WINDOW)?

Are there component tests covering visibility toggle, grouping format, none-yet/unknown display, level thresholds at the 79/80/99/100 percent boundaries (property over fill/window), source labels, and a test that drives a real `chat.done` through the hook path to confirm the re-query of `/models/runtime`? Verify `grep -rln "context-meter" tests src --include=*.test.*` (none pre-impl).

Does the meter honour the S-WINDOW contract it consumes from S1 (source word shown only for estimated/assumed, `stale` only for runtime+stale) and never display a window-size control, per the spec exclusion of window configuration?

Is the meter accessible and robust: level conveyed by more than colour (text/`data-level`), theme tokens for ok/warn/error defined in both light and dark themes, no division-by-zero or NaN/Infinity rendering for window 0, fill > window, or huge values?

Does the implementation satisfy AC-UX-1: "With `showContextMeter` false, `[data-testid="context-meter"]` MUST NOT be present in the DOM."? Demand evidence of (a) the production code (file:line), (b) the test(s) that exercise this AC end-to-end through the real producer path, and (c) confirmation the tests are not pure mock-spy proxies (assertions are on observable output, not on call counts alone).

Does the implementation satisfy AC-UX-2: "With `showContextMeter` true and a known fill, the meter MUST display the fill formatted with `en-US` grouping and the percentage returned by `contextPercent` followed by `%`; with fill `none-yet` it MUST display `0` tokens and `0%`."? Demand evidence of (a) the production code (file:line), (b) the test(s) that exercise this AC end-to-end through the real producer path, and (c) confirmation the tests are not pure mock-spy proxies (assertions are on observable output, not on call counts alone).

Does the implementation satisfy AC-UX-3: "With `showContextMeter` true and an unknown fill, the meter MUST display `—` in place of the token count and percentage."? Demand evidence of (a) the production code (file:line), (b) the test(s) that exercise this AC end-to-end through the real producer path, and (c) confirmation the tests are not pure mock-spy proxies (assertions are on observable output, not on call counts alone).

Does the implementation satisfy AC-UX-4: "The meter MUST display the new fill after a `chat.done` whose steps carry `usage`, and MUST re-query `/models/runtime` after that `chat.done`, without a page reload."? Demand evidence of (a) the production code (file:line), (b) the test(s) that exercise this AC end-to-end through the real producer path, and (c) confirmation the tests are not pure mock-spy proxies (assertions are on observable output, not on call counts alone).

Does the implementation satisfy AC-UX-5: "The meter's `data-level` attribute MUST be `ok` below 80 %, `warn` from 80 % up to below 100 %, and `error` at or above 100 %."? Demand evidence of (a) the production code (file:line), (b) the test(s) that exercise this AC end-to-end through the real producer path, and (c) confirmation the tests are not pure mock-spy proxies (assertions are on observable output, not on call counts alone).

Does the implementation satisfy AC-UX-6: "The value of `showContextMeter` MUST survive a page reload."? Demand evidence of (a) the production code (file:line), (b) the test(s) that exercise this AC end-to-end through the real producer path, and (c) confirmation the tests are not pure mock-spy proxies (assertions are on observable output, not on call counts alone).

Does the implementation satisfy AC-UX-7: "When the resolved window's source is `estimated` or `assumed`, the meter MUST display that word; when it is `runtime` with `stale: true`, the meter MUST display `stale`."? Demand evidence of (a) the production code (file:line), (b) the test(s) that exercise this AC end-to-end through the real producer path, and (c) confirmation the tests are not pure mock-spy proxies (assertions are on observable output, not on call counts alone).

Does the implementation satisfy AC-STRUCT-2: "`src/lib/context-window.ts` MUST export `resolveContextWindow` and `computeContextFill`, and `grep -rn "computeContextFill\|showContextMeter" server/` MUST return no matches."? Demand evidence of (a) the production code (file:line), (b) the test(s) that exercise this AC end-to-end through the real producer path, and (c) confirmation the tests are not pure mock-spy proxies (assertions are on observable output, not on call counts alone).

use-context-window.ts gates every fetch on `enabled`: with the meter off, nothing re-queries /models/runtime after chat.done, so rememberedContextWindows is not refreshed while hidden. Confirm this is acceptable for AC-CTX-1 (the obligation applies to resolves that happen) and that turning the meter on triggers an immediate resolve (src/lib/use-context-window.ts effect deps include `enabled`).

While the first observation for a model is pending, useContextWindow returns window/fill undefined and the meter shows '—' with no data-level; when the model is not yet discovered (selectedModel undefined) it resolves immediately to remembered/assumed and may relabel after discovery. Is this flash acceptable, and is the stale-response discard (cancelled flag, key-matched observation) covered by tests/unit/use-context-window.test.tsx?

The chat.done signal is exposed as `completedCount` from use-chat-generation.ts (modified outside the meter files, within scope 'post-chat.done runtime refresh'). It increments only on successful completion of the current generation, not on abort/error/superseded streams. Verify chat-workspace.tsx edits stay thin (import, hook call, one conditional render).
